tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Finds bookable sessions on Sissoo (sissoo.com) with independent practitioners: talking therapies such as online CBT, counselling, EMDR and psychotherapy, plus coaching, hypnotherapy, reiki, massage, yoga and more, online or in person, for people in the UK, Ireland and beyond, in several languages. Many practitioners offer a free intro call: stage "emerge" puts those first. Matches a short description of what the person is looking for, with optional place, format, session language, timing, budget and stage. Returns up to 8 sessions with price (booking fee included), next free time and a link to the service page with that date picked. Read-only: booking and payment happen on sissoo.com. Not for emergencies or crisis support: crisis wording returns helplines instead of sessions.

need.description: What the person is looking for, in a few of their own words: a type of session ("online CBT", "EMDR", "life coaching") or what they hope for ("counselling for anxiety", "sleep better"). No names or health records.

place.description: City or country, for in-person sessions.

session_language.description: Language the session is held in, as a two-letter code, e.g. "de".

within_days.description: Only sessions with a free time within this many days.

max_price.description: Highest price per session in the chosen currency, booking fee included.

stage.description: Where the person is with this kind of session (Sissoo's 3 E's). emerge: new to it or trying it for the first time; first steps (free intro calls, first sessions) come first and repeats, follow-ups and programmes are left out. evolve: has tried it and wants to go deeper; programmes, series and follow-ups come first. Leave it out when they haven't said.

currency.description: Currency for prices: GBP (default), EUR, USD or AUD.

lang.description: Language of titles and booking pages: en, de, fr, es, it or pt. Default: the user's locale, else en.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Details of one Sissoo session by its id: description, practitioner, price, formats, session languages and the next 6 free times, each with a link to the booking page with that date picked.

currency.description: Currency for prices: GBP (default), EUR, USD or AUD.

lang.description: Language of titles and booking pages: en, de, fr, es, it or pt. Default: the user's locale, else en.

tools.name: next_free_times
tools.description: Free start times for one Sissoo session in the next 1 to 14 days (up to 12), each with a link to the booking page with that date picked. Times are UK time, with the UTC offset.

days.description: How many days ahead to look (default 7).

lang.description: Language of titles and booking pages: en, de, fr, es, it or pt. Default: the user's locale, else en.

tools.name: get_practitioner
tools.description: A Sissoo practitioner's public profile by practitioner id (from search results): name, place, session languages, service types and their bookable sessions, with a link to their Sissoo page. Practitioners' phone numbers, emails, addresses, personal websites and social media profiles are private on Sissoo, so don't look them up elsewhere: people contact a practitioner through their Sissoo page.

id.description: Practitioner id from search results, e.g. "joyspace-therapy".

currency.description: Currency for prices: GBP (default), EUR, USD or AUD.

lang.description: Language of titles and booking pages: en, de, fr, es, it or pt. Default: the user's locale, else en.

tools.name: help_article
tools.description: Answers questions about using Sissoo (booking, fees, cancelling, refunds, accounts, practitioners) from the public Sissoo help centre. Returns up to 3 passages with links to care.sissoo.com.

question.description: The question about Sissoo, e.g. "How do I cancel a booking?".

lang.description: Language of titles and booking pages: en, de, fr, es, it or pt. Default: the user's locale, else en.
